# Review

## Outcome

**Approved**

## Evidence

- All 7 priority parameter families have provenance metadata: AOB/NOB/comammox Ks values (6 entries), carbonate solver constants (4 code-resident constants documented in PROVENANCE_STATUS.md with doc-comment provenance), denitrification (5 param_meta entries replacing the former self-referencing TODO), shrimp reproduction (4 threshold/suppression entries), shrimp molt minerals (5 entries including ca/mg/gh weights), chloride-nitrite protection factor (1 entry), plant/algae growth (4 entries).
- Confidence tiers are explicit and machine-readable across all enriched TOML files. 19 process param_meta entries and 22+ shrimp param_meta entries each specify confidence as literature/expert/heuristic/placeholder. PROVENANCE_STATUS.md opens with tier definitions table.
- Enriched TOML files load through standard serde deserialization validated by cargo test. No special-case hacks observed — param_meta is optional via serde defaults.
- Developer-facing summary (docs/PROVENANCE_STATUS.md, 175 lines) distinguishes strong anchors from provisional approximations with sections for Nitrogen Kinetics, Carbonate Chemistry, Habitat/Biofilter Scaling, Shrimp Biology, and Parameters Not Yet Annotated. Includes 'How to Use This Summary' section.
- Round 3 amendments resolved: coarse_porous.toml valid_range [0.75, 1.1] now has notes explaining why >1.0 is meaningful for porous media pore-wall surface area; pKa1(T) row includes '≈6.35' 25°C reference; shrimp condition/molt-stress/NH3 tunables (temp_condition_low_divisor_c, temp_condition_high_divisor_c, temp_condition_min_factor, molt_stress_condition_midpoint, molt_stress_thermal_cap, nh3_stress_threshold_mg_n_per_l, nh3_stress_response_scale) now have per-parameter param_meta.
- All tests pass: tank_data 38 tests, tank_scenarios all suites green, tank_core 102 tests. Clippy clean across all three packages. Dedicated regression tests lock denitrification metadata, shrimp condition/NH3 tunables metadata, source-water priority tiers, substrate colonizable-area metadata, and scenario denitrification field mapping.
- Denitrification fields propagate end-to-end through ProcessParamsPreset → scenario materialization → runtime ProcessParams, verified by test process_preset_mapping_carries_denitrification_fields.

## Findings and Gaps

- soft_acidic.toml and ro_like.toml source-water profiles lack per-parameter param_meta (documented in PROVENANCE_STATUS.md as lower priority; representative coverage met via hard_shrimp.toml and moderate.toml).
- inert_sand.toml and inert_gravel.toml substrate files lack colonizable_area_factor param_meta (representative coverage met via active_planted.toml and coarse_porous.toml).
- Carbonate solver constants use doc-comment provenance rather than TOML param_meta since they are code-resident constants, not TOML-loaded presets. This design choice is documented in PROVENANCE_STATUS.md.
- Process routing fractions (assimilation, respiration, excretion splits) and thermal transport constants are listed as pending future annotation in PROVENANCE_STATUS.md.

## Follow-up and Amendments

None.
